Name: OCP Accelerator RAS Message Registry
Description: Standardized Redfish messages for accelerator (GPU, HBM, NVSwitch, accelerator management controller) RAS events. Gives neutral MessageIds to conditions that today arrive as vendor free text or as Oem counters. Link/port events are deliberately left to the OCP AcceleratorFabric registry (ocp-hm-system-gpu-management). DRAFT: the vendor code mapping (NVIDIA XID/SXID, AMD equivalents) is the open work item with the OCP System GPU Management workstream.

AcceleratorSubsystemUnavailable.Description: The accelerator management controller or subsystem stopped answering while the host BMC remained healthy.
AcceleratorSubsystemUnavailable.Message: Accelerator subsystem '%1' managed by '%2' is unavailable.
AcceleratorSubsystemUnavailable.Resolution: Check tray power, cabling and the accelerator management controller. Do not schedule accelerator work on this node until the subsystem is restored. Observed twice in six weeks on one fleet; without this event one occurrence went unnoticed nine days.

AcceleratorSubsystemRestored.Description: The accelerator subsystem is answering again.
AcceleratorSubsystemRestored.Message: Accelerator subsystem '%1' managed by '%2' is available.

GPUXidError.Description: A GPU reported an NVIDIA XID error.
GPUXidError.Resolution: Correlate the XID code with the NVIDIA XID reference. Drain and diagnose the node; replace the GPU if the fault is persistent or uncorrectable.

NVSwitchSxidError.Description: An NVSwitch reported an SXID error.
NVSwitchSxidError.Resolution: Assess NVLink fabric blast radius; drain affected GPUs and diagnose the NVSwitch.

HBMUncorrectableECC.Description: An accelerator's HBM lifetime uncorrectable ECC count increased.
HBMUncorrectableECC.Message: GPU '%1' HBM uncorrectable ECC errors increased to %2.
HBMUncorrectableECC.Resolution: Hard memory fault. Take the GPU out of service and run vendor diagnostics; replace if the count keeps rising.

HBMCorrectableECCRateHigh.Description: An accelerator's HBM correctable ECC rate exceeded the operator's threshold.
HBMCorrectableECCRateHigh.Message: GPU '%1' HBM correctable ECC errors increased by %2 in the last %3 minutes.
HBMCorrectableECCRateHigh.Resolution: Watch for row remapping; schedule a reset in the next maintenance window if remaps are pending.

GPURowRemappingPending.Description: A GPU has a pending HBM row remapping that requires a reset to take effect.
GPURowRemappingPending.Message: GPU '%1' has a pending memory row remapping.
GPURowRemappingPending.Resolution: Schedule a GPU reset during the next maintenance window to apply the remapping.

GPURowRemappingFailure.Description: A GPU HBM row remapping operation failed.
GPURowRemappingFailure.Resolution: Drain the node and replace the GPU.

GPURowRemapCapacityExhausted.Description: One or more HBM banks on a GPU have no remap capacity left.
GPURowRemapCapacityExhausted.Message: GPU '%1' has %2 HBM banks with no remaining row-remap capacity.
GPURowRemapCapacityExhausted.Resolution: The next uncorrectable error in an exhausted bank cannot be remapped. Treat the GPU as an RMA candidate.

GPUFellOffBus.Description: A GPU is no longer present on the PCIe bus.
GPUFellOffBus.Message: GPU '%1' is no longer responding on the PCIe bus.
GPUFellOffBus.Resolution: Drain the node; check PCIe AER counters and reseat or replace the GPU.

GPUPCIeLinkDegraded.Description: A GPU's negotiated PCIe link is narrower or slower than its maximum.
GPUPCIeLinkDegraded.Message: GPU '%1' PCIe link is %2 lanes at %3 (maximum %4 lanes at %5).
GPUPCIeLinkDegraded.Resolution: A degraded link halves host-to-GPU bandwidth silently. Check retimers and reseat; a link at 0 lanes with the device still enumerated is a bus drop.

GPUThrottledSustained.Description: A GPU spent more than the operator's threshold of wall-clock time throttled for a thermal or hardware-violation reason.
GPUThrottledSustained.Message: GPU '%1' was throttled for reason '%2' for %3 percent of the last %4 minutes.
GPUThrottledSustained.Resolution: Power-cap throttling under a configured cap is expected; thermal or hardware-violation throttling indicates cooling or a hardware fault.

MetricValueStale.Description: The management controller flagged a telemetry value as stale.
MetricValueStale.Message: Metric '%1' on '%2' is stale; last update %3.
MetricValueStale.Resolution: Do not record the value. If a whole report is stale, treat the accelerator subsystem as degraded.
